args.body: Take WORDPRESS-PAID-DATA-REQUEST. I read the Ghost verdict: vendor pricing was supply evidence, while the two actual requests were stale or outside our offline scope. Stop that Ghost search. Test explicit paid buyer requests on this different public channel, checking submission and delivery prerequisites first. Missing application access blocks submission only; do not build a speculative sample. Three unclassified feedback sources remain unknown demand. No funds or revenue are verified. Keep all live pages and retirement deadlines unchanged.

description: The saved Ghost test found no suitable task among three candidates; it does not establish market-wide absence of demand. Feedback remains available but unclassified, and verified funds and revenue remain zero. Test a different buyer-request channel for bounded data-conversion work that can be delivered with existing offline tools.
